subject: 25 micro-warehouses by June 2027
body:
Hi Nina,

Harbor Parcel's August post says the seed round will pay for 25 new micro-warehouses by June 2027.

At Tidewater Freight I ran launch operations for 18 micro-warehouses in 10 months, and the damaged-parcel rate held under 2%.

Are you hiring someone to own warehouse launches yet? If it is too early for that hire, no reply is needed.

Best,
